name: Sairenji Haruna
source:
Rito's devoted classmate. A kind student and a class icon because of her passionate image. She finds Rito attractive because of his kind and gentle nature. Still, they remain in a friendly state since middle school and both have yet to affirm their feelings to one another.

She has a fear of ghosts, spirits, and monsters, whereas she would faint upon distress.
